info.description:
Todas as queries e mutations do IterStore, com exemplos. Gerada por plan/postman/gerar.php a partir do schema.

1. Importe a collection e o ambiente "IterStore (dev)" e ajuste baseUrl, apiKey e os logins.
2. Rode "01 Autenticação → generateAdminToken" e/ou "generateCustomerToken": o token vai para o ambiente.
3. Checkout: createCart → addToCart → setCartGuestInfo (visitante) → setCartShippingAddress → setCartShippingMethod → setCartPaymentMethod → placeOrder → payOrder. cartId, itemId, número e id do pedido são salvos sozinhos.

Envio de arquivo (uploadProductImage, setCategoryBanners, startTryOn): body form-data, escolha o arquivo no campo "0".

      lastname
      taxvat
      dob
      company_name
      trade_name
      state_registration
      is_ie_exempt
      is_active
      created_at
      updated_at
      attributes {
        code
        value
        values
        option_label
        option_labels
      }
      addresses {
        id
        recipient
        postcode
        street
        number
        complement

graphql.query:
mutation PlaceAdminOrder($cartId: String!, $notifyCustomer: Boolean, $comment: String) {
  placeAdminOrder(cartId: $cartId, notifyCustomer: $notifyCustomer, comment: $comment) {
    id
    number
    status
    statusLabel
    cancelReason
    createdAt
    email
    firstname
    lastname
    taxvat
    items {
      sku
      name
      options
      quantity
      price
      regularPrice
      rowTotal
      discountAmount
    }
    subtotal
    discountAmount
    couponCode
    discounts {
      name
      couponCode
      amount
    }
    shippingAmount
    total
    shippingMethod
    shippingLabel
    shippingDays
    paymentMethod
    paymentLabel
    paymentInstructions
    availablePaymentMethods {
      code
      label
      instructions
    }
    shippingAddress {
      attributes {
        code
        value
        values
      }
      postcode
      street
      number
      complement
      district
      city
      region
      recipient
      telephone
    }
    billingAddress {
      attributes {
        code
        value
        values
      }
      postcode
      street
      number
      complement
      district
      city
      region
      recipient
      telephone
    }
    websiteId
    websiteName
    salesChannel
    customerId
    shipment {
      carrier
      trackingCode
      createdAt
      sourceName
    }
    history {
      status
      comment
      customerNotified
      adminUsername
      createdAt
    }
  }
}
